title: Third Gear
logline: At a small roadside repair shop, broken vehicles arrive all day, each one carrying a customer who is already frustrated before they say a word. The mechanic fixes what is broken and, without quite trying to, absorbs what people bring with it.
human_question: What happens to a day made entirely of other people's small refusals?

premise.story: A long working day at a three-wheeler or motorcycle repair shop: vehicles arriving broken, customers' first words, waiting, bargaining, repair, and the mechanic's own mood shifting as the hours pass.
premise.place: A small workshop on a provincial main road, tools and parts within arm's reach.
premise.experience: The viewer feels the accumulation of a day: each small breakdown a small refusal of someone's plan, and the workshop as the place all of those refusals pass through.

concept_links.why: 'Not getting what one wants' and 'when what one asks for is not given' are named directly among the ordinary occasions for this state of mind [C007-P:L49; C007-M:L17]. A repair shop is where a whole day's worth of those small refusals arrive, one customer at a time.

Restlessness is one of the four factors present in every state of this kind, described as a mind that will not settle on what is in front of it [C022-P:L73; C022-M:L19]. A long day of interruptions and impatient customers is an everyday register of that same unsettling.

what_camera_could_observe: Vehicles arriving broken, and the first words exchanged
The mechanic's hands at work, and the tools of the trade
Waiting customers: phones checked, small complaints, bargaining over price and time
The mechanic's own mood across the day, in quiet moments between jobs
The shop closing, and whatever is left unresolved
what_must_be_real: The shop, the mechanic and the customers' visits must all be genuine and unscripted. No breakdown, delay or disagreement may be arranged for the camera.

possible_arc.opening: The shop opening; the first vehicle of the day rolled in.
possible_arc.turn: A difficult customer, or a difficult repair, tests the mechanic's patience in view of the camera.
possible_arc.ending_open: However the day actually ends for the mechanic closes the film.

position_hint: opening candidate: a repair shop deals daily in objects marked by damage and mended by hand, which fits Object 3's symbolic hint directly, and a genuinely offered or discarded repaired part could be a natural acquisition moment

requirements: A working roadside repair shop with steady daily traffic
A mechanic willing to be filmed across a full working day
Customers willing to be shown and, where their words are used, to consent

suggestions.name: A roadside repair shop on a provincial main road
suggestions.region: Kurunegala or Kegalle town, North Western or Sabaragamuwa Province
suggestions.why: Busy provincial towns on major road corridors with a steady flow of three-wheeler and motorcycle traffic and many small repair shops.
suggestions.verify: A specific shop and mechanic willing to be filmed must be found and confirmed.

risks: The temptation to provoke or wait for a confrontation rather than observe
Making an ordinary hard day look like a portrait of a short-tempered person
Customers' faces and words used without clear consent
drop_if: No shop or mechanic will allow a full day's observation
The only usable material would require prompting a dispute

connections.note: Both are opening candidates where Object 3's mark of repair could plausibly be acquired; only one should open the group.
The shop's small refusals of the day open into the queue's larger, slower version of the same wait.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
